analysis: Copy-number arm of the HGSOC platinum-resistance hypothesis (Serial SAE manuscript)
classification: Research Use Only / hypothesis-generating. No clinical or regulatory claim.
pre_set_criterion: Pre-specified direction (CN instability / HRD-gene loss / CCNE1 amplification -> platinum-resistant) holds with AUROC>0.5 and bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0.5 in >=2 INDEPENDENT cohorts, with effect sizes + CIs. Non-replication/opposite/fragility reported exactly.
modality_note: Both on-target ZetaBridge sources are DNA copy-number, not RNA. The expression Serial SAE score is NOT computable from them and was not computed. This is the copy-number arm - the same modality as the one prior positive result (BriTROC-1 sig7).
acquisition_note: Raw BriTROC-1 sWGS BAMs (679 files, 511 GB) were NOT downloaded: the ZetaBridge broker is metadata-only (no download/stream/byte-range route in its 34-endpoint OpenAPI), and it was not bypassed with pasted credentials. File-level provenance (accession, MD5, bytes, timepoint, phenotype) for all 679 files was harvested into the KG as AcquisitionReceipts. The CN analyses use already-acquired open-access BriTROC CN objects + MSK KG panel_cna.

BriTROC-1 (CN signatures, sWGS).interpretation: sig7 at relapse AUROC 0.874 with bootstrap CI [0.75,0.97] excluding 0.5 and nominal p=0.035 SUPPORTS the predicted direction, BUT rests on EPV=3 (3 resistant patients), is NOT significant after BH-FDR (q=0.245), and is high-variance. Reproduces the prior positive in tendency; fragile.

BriTROC-1 (breakpoint burden / purity /.modality: shallow-WGS absolute copy-number (breakpoints, purity, ploidy, TP53freq)
BriTROC-1 (breakpoint burden / purity /.interpretation: On a LARGER sample (N=167, EPV=12) genome-wide breakpoint burden and purity trend OPPOSITE the resistance prediction (AUROC 0.40-0.45); ploidy leans positive (AUROC 0.65) but its CI [0.49,0.80] CROSSES 0.5 and q=0.42 (not significant). No absolute-CN feature meets the criterion. This larger-N test does NOT support CN instability predicting primary platinum resistance.

MSK-SPECTRUM (WGS panel_cna).interpretation: 40-specimen CN landscape assembled (CCNE1 amplified 6/40; HRD-gene loss burden distributed 0-6). NO per-specimen platinum-resistance labels are present in the KG layer, and no SPECTRUM clinical/outcome TABLE is reachable via the broker (the referenced Synapse ids are Datasets/Files/Folders: mpIF, scRNA, H&E, Bulk WGS, MSK-IMPACT, cna.tsv, cohort.maf, segments.seg - none queryable for labels). Association is therefore NOT runnable; landscape reported, nothing fabricated.

PDS solid-tumor safety warehouse.interpretation: 92 trials / 16,865 patients across 15 solid-tumor types with ZERO ovarian/gyn arm; cannot serve as an HGSOC external control. Mined value = 13 genomic<->AE toxicity hypothesis edges (RUO), enriched into the KG.

verdict: CN ARM: CRITERION NOT MET. Only ONE labeled cohort (BriTROC-1) yields a feature meeting the pre-set threshold (sig7 relapse, AUROC 0.874, CI excluding 0.5), and it is fragile (EPV=3, not FDR-significant). The independent, larger-N absolute-CN test on the SAME cohort (breakpoint burden, N=167, EPV=12) does NOT support the hypothesis and trends opposite. MSK-SPECTRUM has CN data but NO reachable resistance labels, so it cannot be the required 2nd labeled cohort. PDS has no ovarian arm. The >=2-independent-cohort criterion is therefore NOT satisfied on labeled data. The copy-number resistance-prediction claim does not replicate beyond a single fragile signal - consistent with the manuscript's own honest verdict.
